description: BTPS 1.2 BoundView checks. Each case is a document whose BoundView is well formed; `expect.show` is whether a receiver shows it, and `expect.problems` lists each failed check by `check` (`keyFacts`, `shownInFull` or `notHidden`) with the key fact (`field`) or element index (`element`) it is about, in any order. `written` gives a bound value (`value`: text, money in minor units, a date, or basis points) and its binding, and the exact string a receiver draws.
